home.cardExpensesInfoBody1: Konke kukhokhiswe emakhadini akho esikweletu kule nyanga — ukuswayipha, ukuthenga ku-inthanethi, inkokhelo ye-UPI eyenziwe ekhadini. Ukuze ubone ngayinye, vula Izindleko bese ukhetha isihlungi Sekhadi.
home.cardExpensesInfoBody2: Ukusetshenziswa kwekhadi akukaze kwengezwe ezindlekweni zasebhange ngenhla. Leyo mali ayikaphumi ebhange lakho; iyahamba uma ukhokha isikweletu.
home.billPaidInfoBody1: Imali efinyelele emakhadini akho esikweletu kule nyanga futhi yakhokhela lokho obusuvele ukusebenzisile kuwo. Ukuze ubone inkokhelo ngayinye, vula Imali engenayo bese ukhetha isihlungi Sekhadi.
home.billPaidInfoBody2: Ibhili ekhokhwa ngqo ebhange lakho nayo ibalwa ezindlekweni zasebhange, ngoba leyo mali ishiye i-akhawunti yakho. Ayengezwa ezindlekweni zekhadi - lokho okuchithiwe kubalwe ngosuku okwenze ngalo.
home.billPaidInfoBody3: Ikhokhelwe ngezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza? Inani elifinyelele ikhadi liboniswa lapha, kuyilapho ukudonswa kwemali okulixhasile kuhlala ezindlekweni zasebhange ngaphansi kwegama lalolo hlelo lokusebenza, ngakho akukho lutho olubalwa kabili.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody1: Konke okushiye ama-akhawunti akho ebhange nawekheshi kule nyanga: I-UPI nezinkokhelo zamahhala, amasheke, ukukhishwa kwe-ATM, imiyalelo emile, nanoma yini oyingeze ngesandla. Ngayinye ibala ngedethi yayo, futhi ukuthepha ithayela kuklelisa zonke.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody2: Ukusetshenziswa kwekhadi lesikweletu akubalwa lapha. Kungokwekhadi uze uliqedele, ngakho-ke lihlala kumugqa wekhadi lesikweletu ngezansi kunalokho - imali iseku-akhawunti yakho.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody3: Inkokhelo yekhadi lesikweletu ekhokhwe ebhange lakho ibalwa lapha, ngosuku ephuma ngalo ku-akhawunti. Ngaleso sikhathi ukusetshenziswa kwekhadi ekugcineni kufinyelela ebhange lakho, futhi kubalwa kanye kuphela: njengezindleko zasebhange, akuphindi kube yizindleko zekhadi.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody4: Ukuhambisa imali kwenye i-akhawunti yakho nakho kuyabalulekile, ngoba iyishiyile ngempela lena. I-akhawunti eyitholile irekhoda imali engenayo efanayo, ngakho ibhalansi yakho ayishintshile.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody5: Ama-akhawunti owamake njengakhishiwe ashiywa ngaphandle ngokuphelele, kanjalo nanoma yini engaphandle kwale nyanga.
home.sumBankExpensesNote: Yingakho isibalo singabukeka sikhulu ngenyanga okhokhe isikweletu ngayo: isikweletu siyimali ephuma ebhange, nakuba uyisebenzise ngaphambili.
home.sumEverythingSpentNote: Ibhili oyikhokhile ingaphakathi komugqa wokuqala, njengoba leyo mali ishiye ibhange lakho kule nyanga. Ikhadi eliyisebenzisayo likhokhelwe libalwe ekhadini ngenyanga olenze ngayo, ngakho isikweletu semali esetshenziswe isikhathi eside sibalwa kule nyanga nakuleyo.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody1: Yonke into efike ngama-akhawunti akho ebhange nawemali kule nyanga: iholo, inzalo, ukubuyiselwa kwemali, imali etholwe nge-UPI, nanoma yini oyingeze ngesandla. Thepha ithayela ukuze ubone ngayinye.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody2: Imali engenisiwe isuka kwenye i-akhawunti yakho ibalwa, ngoba le akhawunti iye yayithola. I-akhawunti ephuma kuyo inezindleko ezifanayo.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody3: Inkokhelo efika ekhadini lakho lesikweletu akuyona imali engenayo. Isula lokho okukweletayo ekhadini, ngakho livela njengeBill elikhokhelwe kumugqa wekhadi lesikweletu ngezansi.
home.sumBalanceNote: Okushiye ama-akhawunti akho kufaka ibhili yekhadi lesikweletu oyikhokhe kule nyanga, yingakho inyanga enesikweletu ingaphuma iphansi kunalokho ezwakalayo.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody1: Iholo lebhange lale nyanga lisusa izindleko zebhange zale nyanga. Akukho okunye okukuyo, ngakho-ke lezi zibalo ezimbili eziseduze kwayo zihlala zifinyelela kulokhu.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody2: Akuyona imali oyiphethe namuhla. Noma ngabe ama-akhawunti akho angenile ezinyangeni ezedlule akusiyo yini ingxenye yakho - vula ama-Akhawunti ukuze ubone lawo manani asebenzayo.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody3: Isibalo esingaphansi kukaziro simane sisho ukuthi kuningi okushiye ama-akhawunti akho kule nyanga kunokufika, okuvame ukwenzeka lapho ibhili yekhadi lesikweletu yokusetshenziswa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi ingena kuyo.

settings.restoreWarnBody:
Ngenisa izibuyekezo zokwenziwayo namabhajethi kuphela ngebanga ledethi efayelini. Idatha engaphandle kwalolo banga kule foni ihlala. 

Ama-akhawunti: abuyiselwe kusukela kufayela kuphela uma le foni ingenakho ukuthengiselana (isb. ngemva kokufakwa kabusha). Uma kungenjalo ama-akhawunti akho amanje azohlala. 

Uzocelwa ukuthi uphinde ufake izikhumbuzi nohlu lokuthenga. 

Uma ukuvumelanisa kwe-Premium yamafu kuvuliwe, umphumela ohlanganisiwe uyavunyelaniswa (iminyaka engu-~2 yokugcina emafini).

alarms.enableInfo:
Iswishi eyinhloko yezikhumbuzi. Uma ivuliwe, isikhumbuzi sifika njengesaziso sefoni ngesikhathi saso, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi i-MoneyLit ivuliwe noma cha, futhi sivula uhlelo lokusebenza ngokuthi Kwenziwe nokuthi Snuza lapho uluthepha.

Sekuvaliwe, akukho lutho olufikayo.

Sebenzisa amaswishi amabili angezansi ukuze unqume ukuthi izikhumbuzi ziyawenza yini umsindo nokuthi ziyadlidliza yini. Isaziso ngokwaso sihlala sivela.

alarms.offTurnsOffSound: Izikhumbuzi zivaliwe, ngakho akukho lutho oluzokhala noma oluzofika. Umsindo nokudlidliza nakho kuvaliwe, futhi uvule futhi ngale swishi.

alarms.toneNotReceived: Ifoni yakho ayizange itshele i-MoneyLit ukuthi iyiphi ithoni oyikhethile, ngakho akukho okushintshile. Zama futhi, bese ukhetha i-alamu eyodwa yomsindo wefoni kunethoni ozengezile wena.

faq.intro: Impendulo emfushane ethi “ngikwenza kanjani lokho?”, ompompi ababhalwe phansi. Thepha umbuzo ukuze uwuvule, noma sesha igama elifana netimu, ibhajethi noma susa.
faq.qAddTxn: Ngiyengeza kanjani izindleko noma imali engenayo?
faq.aAddTxn:
Inkinobho ethi + emaphakathi nebha engezansi ivula okuthi Engeza Okwenziwayo noma yikuphi kuhlelo lokusebenza. Khetha Izindleko noma Imali engenayo, thepha isigaba esiyingxenye yaso, bese ufaka inani kanye nosuku.

Kukhokhelwe nge / Kutholwe esikrinini esifanayo kunquma ukuthi iyiphi i-akhawunti imali eshiya noma ehlala kuyo, ngakho khetha elungile uma ugcina i-akhawunti engaphezu kweyodwa. Kufanele ungene ngemvume ukuze ulondoloze.
faq.qCardTxn: Ngirekhoda kanjani ukusetshenziswa kwekhadi lesikweletu noma inkokhelo yesikweletu sekhadi?
faq.aCardTxn:
Ithebhu yekhadi lesikweletu kokuthi Engeza Okwenziwayo ivela uma usune-akhawunti yekhadi lesikweletu. Inikeza izinto ezimbili: Izindleko zekhadi lesikweletu zento oyithengile ekhadini, kanye nesikweletu sekhadi lesikweletu senkokhelo oyenza enkampanini yekhadi.

Ukuzihlukanisa kubalulekile. Isikweletu sekhadi sithathwa njengemali esuka ebhange lakho iye ekhadini, hhayi njengezindleko zesibili, ngakho ukukhokha isikweletu akubali ukusetshenziswa okufanayo kabili.
faq.aEditTxn:
Vula uhlu lokwenziwayo kumugqa Wokuhlola esikrinini sokuqala — ukuthepha Izindleko noma Isamba Semali Engenayo kukuyisa ohlwini olufanayo. Thepha okwenziwayo ukuze uvule imininingwane yakhona, bese u-Hlela, ushintshe okungalungile, bese u-Buyekeza.

Ungashintsha inani, isigaba, usuku, inothi kanye ne-akhawunti. Uhlu lubonisa kuphela inyanga oyikhethile, ngakho dlulela kuleyo nyanga kuqala uma umsebenzi usumdala.
faq.aDeleteTxn:
Thepha okwenziwayo ohlwini ukuze uvule imininingwane yakhona, bese ususa. Ikucela ukuthi uqinisekise kuqala, ngoba umsebenzi osusiwe awukwazi ukubuyiselwa emuva.

Ukususa inkokhelo yebhili yekhadi kususa izinhlangothi zombili ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngakho ibhange nekhadi kokubili kubuyela kulokho obekuyikho.
faq.qDeleteMany: Ngiyisusa kanjani imisebenzi eminingana ngesikhathi esisodwa?
faq.aDeleteMany:
Konke ukuthengiselana kuwuhlu kuphela olunamabhokisi omaka. Thepha umugqa ngamunye owufunayo, noma sebenzisa Khetha konke kukho konke okuboniswayo manje, bese ususa bese uyaqinisekisa. Ibha engezansi igcina isibalo salokho okukhethile.

Setha izihlungi zonyaka, inyanga nosuku phezulu kuqala — leyo indlela eshesha kakhulu yokusula inyanga eyodwa, futhi kugcina okuthi Khetha konke ekuthatheni imisebenzi obuhlose ukuyigcina.
faq.aTheme:
Amatimu abala yonke isethi yombala, futhi ukuthepha eyodwa kuyisebenzisa yonke indawo ngokushesha - akukho ukuqalisa kabusha, futhi akukho okunye okushintshayo.

Amatimu ambalwa amakelwe i-Premium. Uma ungabhalisi, ungavula eyodwa ngamadayimane esikrinini se-Diamonds esikhundleni salokho.
faq.qAvatar: Ngisishintsha kanjani isithombe sami noma ngikhethe umlingiswa?
faq.aAvatar:
Isithombe sakho sihlala Kuphrofayela Yami. Thephe, bese ukhetha Okwakudala — isiqalo sakho embaleni wetimu — noma eyodwa yezinhlamvu ze-3D.

Izinhlamvu ziyi-Premium eyengeziwe, futhi zingavulwa ngamadayimane inani elilinganiselwe lezinsuku. Isikrini seDayimane sibonisa izindleko nokuthi ukuvula kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani.
faq.qAppLock: Ngilukhiya kanjani uhlelo lokusebenza ngezigxivizo zeminwe zami?
faq.aAppLock:
Ukukhiya uhlelo lokusebenza kusebenzisa izigxivizo zeminwe, ubuso noma ukukhiya isikrini ifoni esivele inayo, ngakho-ke ayikho iphasiwedi ehlukile okufanele uyikhumbule futhi akukho okugciniwe okwengeziwe. Ukuyivula kukucela ukuthi uqinisekise kanye, ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi iyasebenza.

Ngemva kwalokho uhlelo lokusebenza luyakubuza ukuthi uyivula nini, futhi uma ubuyela kuyo ngemva kwesikhashana — hhayi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma ubuka isaziso. Uma kamuva ususa ukukhiya isikrini ocingweni, uhlelo lokusebenza luyayeka ukubuza kunokuba lukuvalele ngaphandle kwamarekhodi akho.
faq.aLanguage:
Ulimi lufaka uhlu lwazo zonke izilimi uhlelo lokusebenza olutholakala ngalo. Thepha okukodwa bese lonke uhlelo lokusebenza lushintsha ngokushesha, okufaka le-FAQ.

Amagama asemthethweni EmiGomo Yokusebenzisa kanye Nenqubomgomo Yemfihlo ahlala esiNgisini, njengoba leyo kuyinguqulo esebenza ngokusemthethweni. Konke okunye kuhunyushwe.
faq.qImportSms: Ngiyenza kanjani i-SMS yami yasebhange ibe yimisebenzi?
faq.aImportSms:
Ukuthenga ngokungenisa kufunda imilayezo yasebhange esivele ikule foni yenyanga oyikhethayo, bese ibhala lokho ekubona njengezindleko, imali engenayo kanye nezinkokhelo zezikweletu zekhadi. Thikha lezo ozifunayo, lungisa noma yisiphi isigaba, bese Ungeza okwenziwayo.

Umbhalo we-SMS ongahluziwe uhlala kule foni. Uma ulondoloza ukungenisa futhi ukuvumelanisa kwefu kwe-Premium kuvuliwe, lawo marekhodi alondoloziwe angagcinwa emafini. Noma yini eseyingenisiwe imakwe ngakho awukwazi ukuyengeza kabili. Ukufunda i-SMS kuyi-Android kuphela — I-Apple ayivumeli noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthi ikwenze.
faq.qAutoImport: Ingabe ama-SMS asebhange angengezwa ngaphandle kokuthi ngiwangenise njalo?
faq.aAutoImport:
Yebo. Vula Ukungeza ngokuzenzakalela esikrinini se-Ngenisa imisebenzi futhi imilayezo efanisiwe iba imisebenzi ngokwayo njalo uma uvula uhlelo lokusebenza.

Ivaliwe uze uyivule, idinga ukufinyelela kwe-SMS ukuze ivunyelwe kakade, futhi isebenza kuphela ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe. Isikrini esifanayo sisabala yonke into, ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola esikungezile futhi ususe noma yini obungayifuni.
faq.qAddAccount: Ngiyengeza kanjani i-akhawunti yasebhange noma ikhadi lesikweletu?
faq.aAddAccount:
Ama-akhawunti aphethe yonke indawo lapho imali yakho ihlezi khona. Sebenzisa + Faka i-akhawunti, uyinike igama, faka okukuyo namuhla njengebhalansi yokuqala, bese ukhetha uhlobo — Ibhange / Ikheshi / Ikhadi Lesikweletu, noma Ikhadi Lesikweletu.

Uhlobo yilona olugcina ukusetshenziswa kwekhadi kuphuma kubhalansi yakho yasebhange, ngakho ikhadi lesikweletu kufanele lengezwe njengeKhadi Lesikweletu hhayi njenge-akhawunti yasebhange.
faq.qEditAccount: Ngiyiqamba kanjani kabusha noma ngiyisusa kanjani i-akhawunti?
faq.aEditAccount:
Ikhadi le-akhawunti ngalinye esikrinini sama-akhawunti linoHlelo lwegama, ibhalansi yokuqala nohlobo, futhi Susa ku-akhawunti ngokwayo.

I-akhawunti eyodwa yasebhange kanye nekhadi lesikweletu elilodwa kufanele kuhlale njalo, noma ngabe uqambe ngaliphi igama, ngakho elokugcina ngalinye alinakusulwa. Faka esikhundleni kuqala bese esidala sihambe.
faq.qCategory: Ngisengeza noma ngiqambe kanjani kabusha isigaba?
faq.aCategory:
Izigaba zinethebhu Yezindleko kanye neyodwa Ngemali Engenayo. Thepha noma yisiphi isigaba ukuze usiqambe kabusha noma ushintshe isithonjana nombala waso, noma sebenzisa + Engeza isigaba sezindleko ezansi ukuze uthole esisha.

Ukuqamba kabusha kudlulisa okwenziwayo okudala kanye nesabelomali sakho, ngakho-ke akukho okuyintandane. Ukususa isigaba kuhambisa noma yini esetshenziswe Kwabanye, futhi Okunye ngokwako akukwazi ukususwa.
faq.aBudget:
Ithebhu yesabelomali yilapho imikhawulo ihlala khona. Thepha okuthi SETHA IBHAJETHI, khetha isigaba, faka inani bese ulondoloza. Isabelomali ngasinye sibe sesikhombisa ibha yokuthi yimalini oyisebenzisile kule nyanga.

I-⋮ ekhadini lebhajethi ikuvumela ukuthi uyihlele noma uyisuse, futhi Kopisha kusuka enyangeni edlule iletha imikhawulo yenyanga edlule esikhundleni sokuyithayipha futhi.
faq.aReminder:
Vula Izikhumbuzi kusukela kumugqa ongenhla kwamathebhu bese ukhetha uhlobo oludingayo: izikhumbuzi zebhili noma zezindleko, imithi, amadethi okuphelelwa yisikhathi kwegrosa, noma inothi elivamile. Ngayinye inethebhu Entsha lapho ugcwalisa khona imininingwane bese ulondoloza.

Izikhumbuzi zifika njengezaziso zefoni, ngakho zifinyelela kuwe uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe. Lokho kudinga imvume yesaziso, uhlelo lokusebenza oluyicelayo kanye, futhi amafoni aphatha ibhethri ngobudlova asengabamba isexwayiso. Ukuthi izikhumbuzi zenza umsindo noma ukudlidliza kukuwe Ngama-alamu nezaziso.
faq.aBuyList:
Uhlu lokuthenga, kumugqa ongenhla kwamathebhu, olwezinto ohlela ukuzithenga. Thayipha into nenani, yengeze, bese uphawula ngayinye esitolo.

Ihlala iwuhlu ngokwayo: ukumaka into akudali izindleko, futhi akuthumeli lutho ezikhumbuzini.
faq.aSplit:
Hlukanisa, kumugqa ongenhla kwamathebhu, kugcina ukusetshenziswa kwemali okwabiwe. Engeza abangani noma iqembu kuqala, bese wengeza izindleko kuthebhu ethi Izindleko, khetha ukuthi ubani owabelana ngazo, bese ulondoloza. Ibhalansi ikhombisa ukuthi ubani okweletayo ngemuva kokuthi yonke into ibalwe.

I-Split isici se-Premium, ngakho ikucela ukuthi ubone izinhlelo uma i-akhawunti yakho ingenayo.
faq.qCharts: Ngiyibonaphi lapho yashona khona imali yami?
faq.aCharts:
Ithebhu ethi Amashadi ihlukanisa inyanga ekhethiwe ngokwezigaba njengendandatho, futhi ingabonisa imali engenayo esikhundleni sezindleko. Shintsha unyaka, inyanga noma usuku phezulu ukuze ubheke enye inkathi.

Ithebhu Yesabelomali iphendula enye ingxenye yayo - lokho obuhlele ukukusebenzisa ngokumelene nalokho okuchithile ngempela.
faq.aBackup:
Idatha eyisipele ibhala yonke into - okwenziwayo, ama-akhawunti, ibhajethi, izikhumbuzi nohlu lokuthenga - kufayela elilodwa ongazithumela kuwe noma uligcine kusitoreji samafu.

Yenza lokhu ngaphambi kokushintsha amafoni noma ukufaka kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza. Ikhophi yasenqolobaneni iyisici se-Premium. Khipha Idatha iyinto ehlukile: isipredishithi ongasifunda, hhayi ifayela ongakwazi ukubuyisela kulo.
faq.qRestore: Ngiyithola kanjani idatha yami emuva kufoni entsha?
faq.aRestore:
Faka uhlelo lokusebenza, ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti efanayo, bese usebenzisa okuthi Buyisa isipele bese ukhetha ifayela olilondolozile.

Ukubuyisela kungena esikhundleni salokho okusohlelweni lokusebenza manje, ngakho kuyakuxwayisa ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke. Uma ubukade une-Premium enokuvumelanisa kwamafu, idatha yakho ibuya lapho ungena ngemvume ngaphandle kwefayela nhlobo.
faq.aSignIn:
Ukungena ngemvume nge-Google yikho okuvumela uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthi lulondoloze noma yini. Ngaphandle kwakho ungaqalaza, kodwa ukwengeza nokuhlela kuvinjiwe, futhi akukho lutho olugcinwayo.

Iphinde ibophe idatha yakho kuwe kunefoni, ngakho-ke ifoni elahlekile akudingeki isho amarekhodi alahlekile.
faq.aSignOut:
Phuma kuhlezi phansi kwesikrini Sephrofayili futhi ikucela ukuthi uqinisekise.

Ukuphuma ngemvume akususi lutho. Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti efanayo futhi idatha yakho isikhona futhi. Ukuze ususe idatha yakho esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa okuthi Susa yonke idatha kuzilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza.
faq.aPremium:
Ilungu Eliyi-Premium esikrinini Sephrofayili livula isiqhathaniso, esibala zonke izici futhi siphawule ukuthi yini yamahhala nokuthi yini edinga uhlelo. Ngamafuphi: ukuvumelanisa amafu, ukwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni nokubuyisela ifayela, izindleko zokuhlukanisa, I-Smart Insights, zonke izingqikithi nezithombe zezinhlamvu, futhi azikho izikhangiso.

Konke okuphathelene nokulandelela imali usuku nosuku - okwenziwayo, ama-akhawunti, ibhajethi, amashadi, izikhumbuzi, uhlu lokuthenga nokungeniswa kwe-SMS - kumahhala.
faq.aDiamonds:
Amadayimane atholwa ngokubuka ividiyo emfushane, kufika ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, futhi asetshenziswa esikrinini se-Diamonds ukuze kuvulwe izinto ngaphandle kokukhokha: itimu, isithombe somlingisi, noma iphasi elivula izici ze-Premium ngenani elimisiwe lezinsuku.

Iphasi yedayimane ayizisusi izikhangiso - izikhangiso yizo ezizuza amadayimane. Ukumema umngane nakho kuzuza okuthile.
faq.qHomeMonth: Kungani isamba sanyanga zonke sohlelo lokusebenza singafani nebhalansi yami yasebhange?
faq.aHomeMonth:
Isikrini sokuqala siwumbiko wenyanga oyibhekayo: Izindleko Nemali Engenayo isamba saleyo nyanga, futhi Ibhalansi ingenye khipha enye. Akuyona imali onayo.

Okubambayo empeleni kusesikrinini sama-Akhawunti, esibalwa nyanga zonke kanye nebhalansi yokuqala ye-akhawunti ngayinye. Umugqa wekhadi lesikweletu usebenza ngendlela efanayo - okuchithwe ekhadini kule nyanga, nokuthi yini ekhokhelwe kulo.
faq.qContact: Ngiyibika kanjani inkinga noma ngicele isici?
faq.aContact:
Impendulo kuzilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza ithumela umlayezo ngqo kithi, futhi isikrini sokuqala sinokubika inkinga bese ucela isici sento efanayo.

Ukusho ukuthi ubukusiphi isikrini nokuthi ubulindele ini kunalokho kwenza inkinga isheshe ukuyithola. Usizo Nemibandela Yokusebenzisa ikhava ukuthi ingxenye ngayinye yohlelo lokusebenza ihloselwe ukusebenza kanjani.

terms.guide3Body:
Izigaba ezingezansi zihamba kuzo zonke izici ngokulandelana kwazo, kusukela kusikrini sasekhaya kuye ku-akhawunti yakho nedatha. Ngayinye ichaza ukuthi isici senzani nokuthi siziphatha kanjani, ukuze wazi ukuthi yini ovuma ukuyisebenzisa.

Ezinye izici zingacishwa, zibe nentengo ehlukile, noma zikhishwe kancane kancane umshicileli, ngakho okubona kuhlelo lokusebenza kuyigama lokugcina. Amanani nezintengo ezishiwo lapha kungokwakhona futhi zingashintsha.
terms.guide31Body:
Ibhendi ephezulu kokuthi Ikhaya ibonisa Izindleko, Imali engenayo kanye nebhalansi yenyanga yekhalenda yamanje. Ukuthepha Izindleko noma Imali engenayo ivula uhlu olufanayo.

Uma unekhadi lesikweletu, umugqa wesibili uhlala ngaphansi nezibalo ezimbili zenyanga: lokho okukhokhise emakhadini akho, nalokho okukhokhele ezikweletini zawo. Ibhili yekhadi oyikhokhile nayo ibalwa njengemali ephuma ku-akhawunti oyikhokhile, ngakho imigqa emibili ihlanganisa yonke into oyisebenzisile.

Ungakwazi ukufihla ibhendi yesifinyezo, ukhethe ukuthi ikhaya liyavula yini kokuthi Izindleko noma Imali engenayo, futhi usethe ukuthi okwenziwayo kuhlelwa kanjani, kokuthi Izilungiselelo Zohlelo Lokusebenza ngaphansi kwekhasi Lasekhaya.
terms.guide32Body:
Inkinobho ethi + ivula ifomu lokungeza. Khetha Izindleko, Imali Engenayo noma Ikhadi Lesikweletu, khetha isigaba, bese ufaka inani, i-akhawunti eliphuma kuyo noma eya kuyo, idethi, kanye nenothi ozikhethela lona.

Ungakwazi ukunamathisela isithombe sebhili kumsebenzi. Okufakiwe kwegrosa kungahlukaniswa kube izinto ngazinye ezinedethi yokuphelelwa yisikhathi, okungase kukukhumbuze ngokuzenzakalelayo igrosa.

Noma yikuphi okwenziwayo kungahlelwa noma kususwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokuthepha kuhlu.
terms.guide33Body:
Ikhadi lesikweletu aliyona ibhodwe lemali, ngakho-ke i-App iyigcina ihlukile kuma-akhawunti aphethe imali yangempela. Okukhokhisayo ekhadini yizindleko ekhadini, futhi “Isikweletu sekhadi lesikweletu” amarekhodi akhokha ikhadi njengemali edluliswayo esuka ku-akhawunti ekhokhelwe ekhadini.

Umthethosivivinywa ubalwa njengemali ephuma ku-akhawunti ekhokhayo, kuyilapho umuntu echitha ukuhlala ebaliwe ekhadini, ngakho-ke imali efanayo ayibalwa kabili. Ikhaya kanye Nesifinyezo Sokwenziwe sibonisa zombili izinombolo zenyanga: ezikhokhiswayo ekhadini, futhi ezikhokhelwe kulo.

Uhlelo lokusebenza alulandeleli umkhawulo wakho wesikweletu noma i-headroom esele kuwo. Ibhange lakho kuphela eliwazi umkhawulo futhi yiliphi elisebenzisa isitatimende esikhavwe, ngakho-ke noma iyiphi isibalo esisetshenziswe uhlelo lokusebenza emilayezweni yakho iyodwa singaba yiphutha. Hlola isitatimende sekhadi lakho ukuze uthole umkhawulo ongawuthola.
terms.guide34Body:
Ama-akhawunti yilapho imali yakho ihlala khona. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili: i-akhawunti yemali, ekhonjiswa njengeBhange / Ikhadi Lemali / Ikhadi Ledebhithi, kanye Nekhadi Lesikweletu. Ungangeza ama-akhawunti engeziwe, uwaqambe kabusha, uwanikeze isithonjana, noma ufihle ongasayisebenzisi.

Nge-akhawunti yemali i-App ibonisa ukuthi yini ebikhona kuze kube sekupheleni kwenyanga edlule, imali engenayo nezindleko zale nyanga, kanye nebhalansi ewumphumela. Ekhadini lokuthenga ngesikweletu likhombisa ukuthi likhokhiswe ini nokuthi yini ekhokhelwe kulo kule nyanga, kanti ibhalansi yalo ifundeka njengenani elibi isikhathi eside njengoba likukweleta.

Ibhalansi ibalwa kusukela kubhalansi yakho yokuqala kanye nayo yonke into oyirekhodile kusukela lapho. Uhlelo lokusebenza alulokothi luxhumane nebhange lakho ukuze lizihlole.
terms.guide35Body:
Isikrini se-Transactions sibonisa imali engenayo noma izindleko zosuku olukhethiwe, inyanga noma unyaka. Umugqa wama-chips ikuvumela ukuthi unciphise uhlu lube yi-akhawunti eyodwa, futhi isamba salokho kubuka okuhlungiwe kuboniswa eceleni.

Isifinyezo esiphezulu sibonisa Ikhaya: Izindleko, Imali engenayo kanye nebhalansi yama-akhawunti akho emali, nalokho okukhokhiswe emakhadini akho esikweletu nokuthi yini ekhokhelwe kuwo ngomugqa wawo ngezansi.

Izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza ziphinde zinikeze ngokubuka Konke okwenziwayo, lapho ungakwazi ukuhlunga ngesikhathi, ukhethe imigqa eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, bese uyisusa ndawonye.
terms.guide36Body:
Ku-Android Uhlelo Lokusebenza lungafunda imilayezo yasebhange kakade isebhokisini lakho lokungenayo futhi iyenze ibe imisebenzi esalungiswa. Icela imvume ye-SMS kuqala, futhi ungenqaba. Imilayezo ifundwa kudivayisi yakho futhi ayilayishwa ndawo.

Iskena iwindi lakamuva lemilayezo, ibale inani, idethi, umthengisi, noma ngabe bekuyimali engenayo noma ephumile, nokuthi iyiphi i-akhawunti noma ikhadi elisetshenzisiwe, bese iqagela isigaba esivela egameni lomthengisi. Imilayezo okungeyona imisebenzi, njengamaphasiwedi esikhathi esisodwa, izinkokhelo ezihlulekile, izitatimende, izaziso zedethi yamanqamu kanye neminikelo yemali mboleko noma yomkhawulo wesikweletu, iyahlungwa.

Imali ekhishwa ku-ATM yeqiwa ngamabomu. Ibhalansi yakho yasebhange kanye nokheshi osesandleni sakho kuhlala ku-akhawunti efanayo, ngakho ukuhoxiswa akunyakazi lutho phakathi kwakho, futhi imali oyisebenzisela kuyo imali iwukungena okufanele ube nakho. Ukudweba ukheshi ekhadini lesikweletu kuyaboleka, ngakho lokho kusangeniswa kwamanye amazwe.

Akukho okulondolozwayo uze uqinisekise. Ungakhetha noma usule yonke into, ususe umakhi imigqa ngayinye, futhi ushintshe isigaba ngaphambi kokungenisa. Imigqa osuvele uyingenisile iyakhunjulwa futhi ngeke yengezwe kabili.

Lapho i-SMS ingatholakali khona unganamathisela umbhalo womlayezo. Okufakiwe okungenisiwe kunembile kuphela njengemilayezo evela kuyo, futhi unesibopho sokuyihlola.
terms.guide37Body: Okwenziwayo kuhlanganiswe ngezigaba ezifana nezitolo zokudla, ukudla, ezokuthutha, ukuqashwa, i-EMI, izikweletu kanye Nemiholo. Ungengeza eyakho ngophawu olukhethiwe nombala, uqambe kabusha noma ususe lezo ozingezile, bese usetha kabusha uhlu lubuyele kokumisiwe. Isigaba esithi Okunye asikwazi ukususwa, ngakho-ke akukho lutho olusala lungenalo ikhaya.
terms.guide38Body: Ungasetha umkhawulo wanyanga zonke wanoma yisiphi isigaba sezindleko futhi ubuke ukuthi yini oyichithile ngokumelene nayo, okuhlanganisa ukukopisha imikhawulo yenyanga edlule kulesi. Isabelomali singumhlahlandlela wakho; i-App ayikuvimbi ukusebenzisa imali noma ikuvimbe ukurekhoda okwenziwayo okudlula kokukodwa.
terms.guide39Body:
Amashadi abonisa ukuthi imali yakho yashonaphi njengokuhlukaniswa kwesigaba, kanye nezitayela zokusebenzisa imali kanye nokuqhathaniswa kwenyanga nenyanga. Ikhalenda libonisa usuku ngalunye lwenyanga nesamba salo, futhi ngokuthepha usuku lwenza uhlu lwalolo suku.

I-Smart Insights ifunda idatha yakho erekhodiwe kudivayisi yakho futhi ikhomba izinto ezifana nesabelomali osusondele ukusidlula, isigaba esiyeqe uma siqhathaniswa nenyanga edlule, noma inyanga engenayo imali erekhodiwe. Imininingwane iwukuqaphela okufakile, hhayi iseluleko, futhi iyisici se-Premium.
terms.guide310Body: Incwadi yemali iyisethi ehlukile yama-akhawunti, ukuthengiselana kanye nesabelomali, ukuze ukwazi ukugcina, isibonelo, amarekhodi asekhaya nawebhizinisi ngokuhlukana. Uqala ngeyodwa ebizwa ngokuthi Okomuntu siqu, futhi ungakha ezengeziwe, uziqambe kabusha, ushintshe isithonjana sazo, ufake kungobo yomlando lezo oqede ngazo, noma uzisuse. Ibhuku olivulile kuphela eliboniswa noma yikuphi ku-App.
terms.guide311Body:
Indawo yokusebenza Yezikhumbuzi ihlanganisa izikweletu eziphindelelayo, imithi enemithamo yasekuseni, ntambama nakusihlwa, igrosa esondela kwidethi yokuphelelwa yisikhathi, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezivamile. Ungasetha ukuthi uxwayiswa kude kangakanani, ukuthi isexwayiso sansuku zonke sifika ngasiphi isikhathi, nokuthi i-alamu ikhale isikhathi esingakanani, futhi ungahlola i-alamu nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

Izikhumbuzi ziwusizo kuphela. Ukuthi umuntu uyafinyelela kuwe ngempela kuncike kuzilungiselelo zedivayisi yakho, izimvume, isimo sebhethri nemikhawulo yesistimu yokusebenza, ngakho-ke sicela unganciki kuyo nganoma yini ebalulekile.
terms.guide312Body:
Indawo yokusebenza yokuthenga igcina uhlu olulula lwezinto ezinamanani ongasesha futhi umake njengoba uthenge.

Indawo yokusebenza ye-Split ikuvumela ukuthi wabelane ngezindleko nabangane namaqembu, uhlukanise inani ngokulinganayo, ngamanani aqondile, ngamaphesenti, ngamasheya noma ngokulungiswa, futhi igcina irekhodi elisebenzayo lokuthi ubani ukweleta ini. Idinga i-akhawunti ongene kuyo ngemvume futhi iyisici se-Premium. Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina irekhodi kuphela; ayisusi imali phakathi kwakho nanoma ubani omunye.
terms.guide313Body: Ukusesha okuvela kunhlokweni kubheka kukho konke okwenzile, izikhumbuzi, izinto zokuthenga nezilungiselelo. Ungashintsha uhlobo lwemali lokubonisa olusuka kunhlokweni ye-chip, eshintsha indlela amanani aboniswa ngayo futhi ingawaguquli. I-App itholakala ngezilimi eziningi. Lo mhlahlandlela nawo uhunyushwe, kuyilapho izingxenye zomthetho zeMigomo Yokusebenzisa zinikezwe ngesiNgisi.
terms.guide314Body: Ungashintsha ukubukeka kohlelo lokusebenza ngezindikimba futhi unikeze iphrofayela yakho isithombe somlingiswa. Itimu yamahhala ihlala itholakala, futhi okunye kungavulwa nge-Premium noma kuqashwe ngamadayimane.
terms.guide315Body:
Amadayimane angumvuzo wangaphakathi nohlelo ongenalo inani lemali. Angeke athengwe, athengiswe, adluliswe noma ashintshiwe ukuze athole imali, futhi awabuyiswa.

Uzithola ngokukhetha ukubuka isikhangiso esiklonyelisiwe kuze kube sekupheleni, nangokumema abangani. Kunomkhawulo wokuthi mangaki ongawazuza ngezikhangiso usuku ngalunye. Ibhalansi yakho kanye nomkhawulo wansuku zonke kuyabanjwa futhi kuhlolwe kuseva yethu kusetshenziswa isikhathi seseva, ngakho ukushintsha iwashi ledivayisi yakho ngeke kwandise lokho ongakuzuza.

Ungasebenzisa amadayimane ngephasi ye-Premium ethatha inani elimisiwe lezinsuku, noma ezintweni ezengeziwe ezingazodwana njenge-avatar, itimu, noma I-Smart Insights isikhathi esithile. Iphasi noma ukuvula okuthengwe ngamadayimane kukunikeza isici ngesikhathi saso esishiwo kuphela, ngemva kwalokho sivele siphele. Izintengo, umvuzo ngesikhangiso ngasinye kanye nomkhawulo wansuku zonke kuboniswa kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi kungashintsha noma kunini.

Iphasi ye-Premium etholwe ngamadayimane ivula izici kodwa ayisusi izikhangiso. I-Premium ekhokhelwayo kuphela ayinazikhangiso.
terms.guide316Body:
I-akhawunti ngayinye engene ngemvume ithola ikhodi yayo yesimemo. Uma umngane efaka ikhodi yakho, nobabili nithola amadayimane, ngaphansi komkhawulo wokuthi zingaki izimemo eziklonyeliswayo.

Ikhodi ingasetshenziswa kanye kuphela kumuntu ngamunye, awukwazi ukusebenzisa eyakho, futhi singase sigodle imiklomelo lapho sikholelwa ukuthi amakhodi ahlukunyezwa, isibonelo ngama-akhawunti ayimpinda noma azenzakalelayo.
terms.guide317Body:
Ukusetshenziswa kwamahhala kugcina amarekhodi akho kudivayisi yakho, kubonisa izikhangiso, futhi kushiye izici ezithile zikhiyiwe. Futhi ivula izici ngazinye ozikhethayo, futhi i-Premium ivula yonke into, isuse izikhangiso, futhi inike amandla ukuvumelanisa kwamafu.

Inkokhelo yenziwa mathupha yi-UPI, ngemva kwalokho usithumelela inkomba yokukhokha bese sivula i-akhawunti yakho. Ngakho-ke ukwenza kusebenze akusheshi. Izintengo, okuqukethwe kohlelo nezikhathi zokukhokha kuboniswa ohlelweni lokusebenza futhi zingashintsha; izinguquko asithinti isikhathi osuvele usikhokhele.
terms.guide318Body:
Abasebenzisi bamahhala bangabona isibhengezo nezikhangiso zomdabu ezingxenyeni zohlelo Lokusebenza, futhi bangakhetha ukubuka izikhangiso zevidiyo eziklonyelisiwe ukuze bathole amadayimane. Ukubuka isikhangiso esiklonyelisiwe kuhlala kuwukuzikhethela kwakho futhi akudingekile ukuthi usebenzise isici osuvele unaso.

Izikhangiso zinikezwa izinkampani zangaphandle futhi zingaphansi kwemigomo nezinqubomgomo zobumfihlo zabo. I-Paid Premium iyawasusa.
terms.guide319Body:
Nge-Premium ne-akhawunti ongene kuyo ngemvume, amabhuku akho emali, okwenziwayo, amabhajethi, izikhumbuzo, izigaba nezithombe zezikweletu ezinamathiselwe zingavunyelaniswa ukuze ukwazi ukucosha kwenye idivayisi. Ukuvumelanisa kudinga uxhumano olusebenzayo futhi kungase kubambezeleke noma kungapheleli, ngakho sicela ungakuphathi njengekhophi yakho kuphela.

Isitoreji samafu ngokuvamile sigcina cishe iminyaka emibili yokugcina yamarekhodi asesikhathini samanje. Okufakiwe okudadlana kuhlala kudivayisi ekudalile.

Ungangena ngemvume kuphela kudivayisi eyodwa ngesikhathi; ukungena ngemvume kwenye indawo kuphelisa iseshini yangaphambili.
terms.guide320: 3.20 Yenza isipele, thekelisa futhi usule idatha yakho
terms.guide320Body:
I-Premium ikuvumela ukuthi ulondoloze ifayela eliyisipele ledatha yakho bese ulibuyisela kamuva. Ukubuyisela kungena esikhundleni salokho okukhona manje kudivayisi, futhi ukunakekela ifayela kuwumthwalo wakho. Ungakwazi futhi ukuthekelisa ukuthenga kwakho njengesipredishithi sebanga ledethi olikhethayo.

Ungasusa idatha yakho noma kunini: kule divayisi, emafini, noma kokubili. Ukususwa kungunaphakade, ngakho thatha ikhophi yasenqolobaneni kuqala uma ungase uwafune amarekhodi futhi.
terms.guide321Body: Ungaqalaza ingxenye enkulu yohlelo lokusebenza ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Ukulondoloza amarekhodi akho, ukungenisa imilayezo, ukuzuza noma ukusebenzisa amadayimane, nokuvumelanisa konke kudinga ukuthi ungene ngemvume, ongakwenza nge-Google, i-Apple noma ikheli le-imeyili nephasiwedi.
terms.guide322Body:
Izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza zinenketho ethi Susa i-akhawunti. Sikubuza ukuthi kungani uhamba, futhi uma usuqinisekisile, i-akhawunti iyacishwa ngokushesha: uphumile, awukwazi ukungena ngemvume futhi, futhi yonke into ebanjwe kuleyo foni iyasulwa. Thatha ikhophi yasenqolobaneni kuqala uma ungase ufune amarekhodi.

Isicelo bese siya kumlawuli, osusa i-akhawunti kanye nekhophi yayo yamafu kumarekhodi ethu. Kuze kube lokho kwenzeka i-akhawunti ihlala ivaliwe futhi ingasetshenziswa. Uma uyivale ngephutha, bhala ukuze uyisekele ngokushesha futhi kungenzeka uyibuyisele.

Izindleko owabelane ngazo ku-Split hlala nabangane owabelane ngazo nabo, ukuze ibhalansi yabo iqhubeke. Isizathu osinikezile sigcinwa ngaphandle kwegama lakho, njengezibalo.

notifications.emptyBody: Izikweletu ezifikayo, igrosa esezophelelwa yisikhathi, amabhajethi osudlule kuwo kanye nomsebenzi ohlukanisayo konke kuvela lapha.

deleteAccount.effectSplit: Hlukanisa izindleko owabelane ngazo hlala nabangane bakho, ukuze ibhalansi yabo iqhubeke.

deleteAccount.doneBody: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe futhi isemgqeni wokususwa. Siyabonga ngokusitshela ukuthi kungani.
deleteAccount.guestBody: Uphequlula njengesivakashi, ngakho-ke ayikho i-akhawunti ezosuswa. Noma yini ofuna ihambile ingasulwa ngaphansi kokuthi Idatha.
faq.aNotifications: Insimbi eseduze nohlobo lwemali ibamba noma yini ekulindile: izikweletu ezifikayo noma esezifike sekwephuzile, igrosa esezophuma, imithi engakaphuzwa, isabelomali osudlule kuso kule nyanga, izicelo zobungane nezinkokhelo ozoziqinisekisa ku-Split, kanye nezinkokhelo zohlelo lokusebenza olungezwe ku-SMS yakho. Imigqa izishiya yodwa uma usubhekane nento engemuva, ngakho insimbi engenalutho isho ukuthi akukho okukudingayo.
faq.aDeleteAccount: Vula izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza bese uthepha okuthi Susa i-akhawunti. Khetha isizathu, bese uyaqinisekisa. I-akhawunti yakho iyacishwa ngokushesha, uphumile, futhi yonke into ekule foni iyasulwa — ngakho thatha isipele kuqala uma ungase ufune amarekhodi. Umphathi ube esesusa i-akhawunti kanye nekhophi yayo yamafu kumarekhodi ethu. Hlukanisa izindleko owabelane ngazo hlala nabangane bakho ukuze amabhalansi abo asangane.

help.startBody:
{name} ikusiza ukuthi ulandelele imali, izikhumbuzi, nohlu lokuthenga.

Ngena ngemvume ukuze ulondoloze idatha yakho. Izivakashi zingaphequlula kodwa azikwazi ukwengeza noma ukuhlela amarekhodi.
help.balanceBody:
Iholo Lekhaya, Izindleko, Nebhalansi okwenyanga ekhethiwe kuphela (imali engenayo - izindleko zaleyo nyanga).

Akuyona isamba sakho esigcwele se-wallet. Amabhalansi e-akhawunti aphila ngaphansi kwama-Akhawunti.
help.accountsBody:
Ukheshi kanye neBhange kubambe imali yakho. Inani elikhona yilokho osekuvele kukhona ngaphandle kwemali engenayo yale nyanga. Imali engenayo yenyanga yamanje yengezwa isuka Ekhaya → Imali engenayo (Itholwe ngaphakathi).

Sebenzisa Okukhokhelwe nge / Okutholiwe ukuze okwenziwayo ngakunye kufinyelele ku-akhawunti efanele. Amagama e-akhawunti ayimpinda ahlanganiswa aba elilodwa.
help.monthlyBody: Ekhadini le-akhawunti ngalinye, vula ibhalansi yanyanga zonke ukuze ubone amanani kuze kube sekupheleni kwenyanga ngayinye (ngokwesibonelo Kuze kube nguMeyi, Kuze kube nguJuni). Inombolo enkulu ekhadini isamba sakho esihlanganisiwe namuhla.
help.buyListBody: Engeza izinto ohlela ukuzithenga. Esitolo, phawula into ngayinye ngendlela ekhethiwe. Uhlu lokuthenga aluzithumeli izinto Ezikhumbuzini Zezezimali noma Zokudla.
help.remindersBody: Sebenzisa Izikhumbuzi ngezikweletu, imithi, ukuphela kwesikhathi segrosa, namanothi ajwayelekile. Ama-alamu ancike kuzimvume zefoni yakho kanye nezilungiselelo zamandla.
help.premiumBody:
I-Premium ivula okwengeziwe njengezingqikithi, ama-avatar abalingiswa, I-Smart Insights, ikhophi yasenqolobaneni/ukubuyisela ifayela, nokuvumelanisa kwamafu.

I-Free igcina idatha ikakhulukazi kule foni futhi ingase ibonise izikhangiso.

Ama-akhawunti omlawuli afaka i-Premium futhi akhululekile emikhawulweni yokugcinwa kwamafu echazwe ngaphansi kokuvumelanisa Kwamafu.
help.cloudBody:
Ukuvumelanisa kwamafu kuyisici se-Premium. Ngenkathi i-Premium isebenza, ifu ligcina cishe iminyaka emibili yokugcina yedatha yezezimali yakamuva (imisebenzi, amabhajethi, izithombe zezikweletu ezihlobene). Izikhumbuzi nohlu lokuthenga kuhlala kuso sonke isikhathi se-Premium.

Idivayisi eyodwa kuphela engakwazi ukuhlala ingene ngemvume ngesikhathi.

Uma i-Premium iphela, idatha yefu ibanjwa isikhathi somusa esiyizinyanga ezi-3 ngaphandle kokuvumelanisa okwengeziwe. Uma uvuselela kulelo windi, ukuvumelanisa kuyaqhubeka. Uma ungavuseleli, yonke idatha yefu ye-akhawunti yakho iyasuswa futhi uqhubeka njengomsebenzisi Wamahhala. Idatha kule foni ayisuswa yilokho kusula kwamafu.

Abaphathi bakhululiwe ku-prune yeminyaka engu-2 kanye ne-post-grace cloud cloud.
help.backupBody:
Yenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni / Buyisela (i-Premium) yabelana noma ngenisa ifayela le-JSON.

Ukuthumela kuhlanganisa isifinyezo sedatha yakho kanye nedatha ozikhethela yonaQala / idathaIzinsuku zokuphela zokuthenga kwakho.

Ukungenisa akusuli yonke into. Ibuyekeza imisebenzi nesabelomali sesigaba kuphela ngebanga ledethi efayelini; idatha engaphandle kwalolo banga kule foni ihlala. Ama-akhawunti athathwa efayelini kuphela uma le foni ingenakho ukuthengiselana (isibonelo ngemva kokufakwa kabusha); uma kungenjalo ama-akhawunti akho amanje ahlala. Uzocelwa ukuthi uphinde ufake izikhumbuzi nohlu lokuthenga.

Uma ukuvumelanisa kwe-Premium yamafu kuvuliwe, umphumela ohlanganisiwe uvunyelaniswa nefu (kusephakathi kwewindi lefu leminyaka engu-~2).

Amafayela e-JSON owalondoloza kokuthi Amafayela, IDrayivu, noma i-imeyili ahlala elawulwa nguwe futhi awasuswa lapho idatha yefu ihlanzwa.

Ukusula inqolobane kususa kuphela amafayela okuthumela esikhashana — akususi okwenziwayo noma izilungiselelo.
